verdict.rationale: The IAM docs say Claude Pro or Max subscribers log in with their Claude.ai account, and that individuals can use a claude.ai account while teams use Claude for Teams or Enterprise (with SSO on Enterprise). Community users report actually running Claude Code on a Pro plan and on a gifted subscription, which corroborates the docs. Missing for 10: documented per-plan usage limits and quota behavior when signed in via subscription, given one user's report that Opus drains Pro tokens quickly.
